purpose: Links a stored picture to a record's picture fact and reads the link back, and runs the add, replace, remove and delete order so no picture file is orphaned and no record is lost.

host.replaces: the app's picture fact name (run-7 PICTURE_FACT, run-6 PICTURE_FACT); this unit holds none
run-7 FlowDeps (src/plant/pictureFlow.ts): the app's own record create, link, copies and delete

library.title: Record picture link and flow (attach, replace, remove or delete a record's picture, with the files ended in the right order)
library.note: Attaches a stored picture to a record's picture fact (a PATCH with If-Match, read back to check the link stuck, both the string and the link forms read), and runs the add, replace, remove and delete order so no picture file is orphaned: record-first or picture-first, old files ended only after the new link held, files ended before the record is deleted. Also checks a picked file (type, 25 MB) and shrinks it to a screen copy and a thumbnail with EXIF and GPS dropped, and binds picture-set to one vault. The fact name is always passed in; it holds no term. The upload itself is picture-set, the shrinking picture-shrink, the record calls lws-records. Also found as: record picture; attach a photo to a record; take or upload a record's picture.
